headline: US Treasury imposes sanctions targeting Iranian oil trustees and proxy networks
summary: The US Department of the Treasury announced new sanctions under Operation Economic Outcast, targeting key oil trustees facilitating Iranian petroleum exports alongside financial networks and charities linked to Hezbollah.
why: US sanctions on Iranian maritime oil trade directly impact shadow-tanker shipping volumes and crude supply dynamics in global energy markets.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Enforcement actions against illicit Iranian crude sales constrain sanction-evading tanker distribution channels.
